sentences: Two unentangled quantum proofs can impose structure that a single unrestricted witness does not provide.
This record asks whether the resulting class \(\mathrm{QMA}(2)\) has the full power of nondeterministic exponential time.
The source reviews protocols compressing satisfiability witnesses and amplification techniques that exploit product-state testing.
Those achievements do not by themselves establish the proposed equality with NEXP.
Determining the class would reveal how much complexity can be hidden in a promise that independently supplied quantum messages share no entanglement.
